app.name: Revive
app.tagline: A calm home for everything you build with AI

welcome.title: Which language should Revive speak?
welcome.subtitle: You can change it any time, from the side menu or from Settings.

settings.subtitle: How Revive looks and talks to you.

interface.title: Interface language
interface.hint: Changes every word and the direction of every screen, right away.

claude.title: Claude answers in
claude.hint: The language Claude uses when it tells you what it found or what it changed.

detail.title: Detail level
detail.simpleHint: Plain words. Commands, ports and logs stay folded away until you open them.
detail.advancedHint: Commands, ports, paths and logs are open on every screen.
detail.example: This is how technical details will look:

scanModel.title: Model for reading your folder
scanModel.hint: The Claude model used when Revive reads a folder. The default is quick and inexpensive.

projects.subtitle: Everything you built, in one place.
projects.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects yet} one {# project} other {# projects}}

notRead.title: Revive hasn't read this folder yet
notRead.body: Claude will look through the folder and describe each project in plain words. It only reads, and Revive saves a version first.

projects.found: {count, plural, =0 {Claude didn't find any projects.} one {Found # project.} other {Found # projects.}}
projects.cost: Claude reported this reading as about {cost, number, ::currency/USD} of usage.
projects.lastRead: Last read {date, date, medium}, {date, time, short}
projects.empty: Claude didn't find any projects in this folder.
projects.invalid: Revive's list of projects for this folder can't be read. Reading the folder again will fix it.
projects.loose: {count, plural, one {# file isn't part of any project.} other {# files aren't part of any project.}}

history.subtitle: Every saved version, so you can always go back.
history.placeholder: Saved versions will be listed here, each with a plain title and a time.
history.keysNote: Keys are never included in saved versions.

prereq.title: Let's check your computer
prereq.subtitle: Revive works with a few tools on your computer. Checking takes a few seconds.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.purpose: Reads your projects and explains them in plain words.

signIn.name: Your Claude account
signIn.purpose: Claude Code works through your own Claude account.

git.name: Git
git.purpose: Keeps saved versions, so you can always go back.

node.name: Node.js
node.purpose: Needed to start most website projects.

install.title: Claude Code isn't installed yet
install.body: Claude Code is the assistant that reads your projects. Revive can install it for you with Anthropic's official installer. It takes about a minute and doesn't ask for your password.
install.confirmBody: Revive will download Anthropic's official installer from claude.ai and run it. It only installs into your own home folder.
install.running: Installing Claude Code. This takes about a minute.
install.failed: The installation didn't finish. You can try again, or install from the official page.

signIn.title: Sign in to your Claude account
signIn.body: Claude Code needs a Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise account. Your browser will open the sign-in page. Come back here when you're done.
signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in, in your browser…
signIn.failed: We couldn't confirm that you signed in. Try again, or type this in Terminal and follow the steps:

git.title: Git isn't installed
git.body: Git keeps your saved versions. On a Mac it comes with Apple's free developer tools. Install them, then check again.

node.note: Without Node.js, Revive can read your projects but can't start most of them. You can install it later.

folder.title: Which folder holds your projects?
folder.subtitle: Pick the folder where you build with Claude Code or Codex. It can hold many projects.

problem.missing: We couldn't find that folder. It may have been moved or renamed.
problem.not-directory: That's a file, not a folder. Drop the folder that holds it.
problem.too-broad: That folder is too big to read as one place. Pick the folder that holds your projects.
problem.unreadable: Revive can't open that folder. Check that you have permission to open it.

promises.title: Your files are safe
promises.readOnly: Revive only reads your projects. Its own notes go into a hidden folder inside the one you choose.
promises.versions: A version is saved before every change, so you can always go back.
promises.noServers: Revive has no servers. Claude reads your code through your own Claude account.

scan.title: Reading your folder

phase.saving: Saving a version first, so nothing can be lost.
phase.checking: Making sure nothing outside Revive's folder changed.
phase.describing: Writing a short description of each project.

scan.timeNote: This usually takes a minute or two.
scan.filesRead: {count, plural, one {# file read} other {# files read}}
scan.projectsFound: {count, plural, =0 {No projects found yet} one {# project found} other {# projects found}}

scanError.version_failed: Revive couldn't save a version first, so it didn't read the folder. Nothing was changed.
scanError.claude_missing: Claude Code isn't installed, so Revive can't read the folder yet.
scanError.auth: You're signed out of Claude, so the reading didn't start.
scanError.modified_outside: Claude changed files outside Revive's folder, so Revive put them back the way they were.
scanError.invalid_manifest: Claude's list of projects came back unreadable, so Revive kept what it had before.
scanError.limit: The reading reached its safety limit and stopped. Big folders sometimes need a second try.
scanError.timeout: Reading took more than 10 minutes, so Revive stopped it.
scanError.cancelled: You stopped the reading. Nothing outside Revive's folder changed.
scanError.unknown: Something went wrong while reading the folder, and we're not sure why yet.
scanError.restored: Put back the way they were:
scanError.quarantined: New files, moved aside into Revive's folder:
scanError.unrestorable: Changed, but not part of the saved version:
scanError.unsafe_claude: This version of Claude Code didn't respect Revive's safety limits, so Revive won't let it read your folder.

project.previewSoon: A live picture of this project will appear here once it has been started.
project.keysNone: This project doesn't need any keys.
project.pictureNote: The picture from the last time it opened.

guard.title: Revive can't safely use this version of Claude Code
guard.body: Revive limits how long Claude may work on each reading. In a short test, Claude Code {version} didn't stop at that limit, so Revive won't let it read your folders. Updating Claude Code usually fixes this.

busy.installing: Getting the parts this project needs. The first time can take a few minutes.

reason.missing_key: It stopped because a key is missing: {purpose}.
reason.port_busy: Another copy of this project is already running.
reason.deps_missing: Some parts this project needs aren't downloaded yet. Checking again will get them.
reason.tool_missing: This project needs {tool}, which isn't installed on this computer.
reason.install_failed: Getting the parts this project needs didn't work.
reason.no_start_command: Revive doesn't know how to start this project yet.
reason.exited: The project stopped on its own.
reason.timeout: The project didn't open in time, so Revive stopped it.
reason.unknown: Something went wrong and we're not sure why yet.
